Abstract: 
 Establishing an effective corporate governance system requires a combination of internal and 
external mechanisms, including internal auditing. This study aims to highlight the role of internal 
auditing in enhancing internal control within organizations in light of the significant advancements 
in the use of information technology. The study revealed that the interaction between internal 
auditing and technology can enhance governance effectiveness by improving the quality of reports, 
supporting decision-making, and ensuring regulatory compliance. Moreover, integrating technology 
with internal auditing is no longer optional but a necessity to improve internal control systems and 
achieve business sustainability in a competitive and dynamic environment. 
Keywords: Governance; Internal auditing; Internal control; Information technology.

Abstract: 
 Establishing an effective corporate governance system requires a combination of internal and 
external mechanisms, including internal auditing. This study aims to highlight the role of internal 
auditing in enhancing internal control within organizations in light of the significant advancements 
in the use of information technology. The study revealed that the interaction between internal 
auditing and technology can enhance governance effectiveness by improving the quality of reports, 
supporting decision-making, and ensuring regulatory compliance. Moreover, integrating technology 
with internal auditing is no longer optional but a necessity to improve internal control systems and 
achieve business sustainability in a competitive and dynamic environment. 
Keywords: Governance; Internal auditing; Internal control; Information technology.

Abstract: 
In the light of the increasing emphasis on the necessity of activating the role of internal audit in 
companies to ensure the effectiveness of internal control system, this paper aims to identify the 
most important theoretical and practical aspects that support the quality of internal audit, and to 
highlight the key dimensions that are considered contributing factors in achieving the quality of 
internal control. 
 Through this paper, we concluded that the quality of internal audit requires continuous 
commitment to professional development, adopting audit practices and programs that keep pace 
with ongoing developments, in addition to ensure the availability of a supportive environment for 
independent oversight that contributes to ensure the quality of internal audit execution.  
Key words: Internal Audit; Quality; Quality of Internal Audit; Improving Quality.

This research paper aims to explore the role of artificial intelligence in enhancing the efficiency 
of internal auditing and to analyze how AI technologies can impact the internal auditing process 
across various business sectors.  The research also aims to present results and recommendations 
based on the analyses and data provided, which can contribute to a deeper understanding of the role 
of artificial intelligence in developing and enhancing internal auditing processes. 
The study concluded that artificial intelligence plays a pivotal role in enhancing the efficiency of 
internal auditing. The results demonstrated that the application of AI technologies, such as machine 
learning and big data analytics, can lead to improved accuracy and effectiveness in audit processes.

Abstract: 
 This study aimed to identify the conceptual framework of information technology, then 
determine the impact of using information technology in its dimensions on the future of the 
accounting and auditing profession. To achieve this goal, the theoretical framework of information 
technology in the field of accounting and auditing was reviewed, then an applied study was 
conducted on the "PWC" company, where a set of results were reached, the most important of 
which were: that the "PWC" company relies on the use of information technology and in applying 
the strategies and techniques of the accounting and auditing profession. And that the applications of 
information technology have led to replacing the accountant and auditor in performing some tasks. 
We concluded the study with a set of recommendations that help increase the effectiveness of using 
information technology in the accounting and auditing profession in the future and strategies related 
to the accounting and auditing profession, the necessity of issuing instructions and guidelines from 
the parties concerned with accounting and auditing using information technology techniques to be 
applied by the accountant and auditor in order to keep pace with modern developments in general 
and at the level of the profession in particular, and informing those working in this profession of the 
fact that in the near future the jobs of the accounting and auditing profession that do not keep pace 
with these developments will be replaced. 
Keywords: information technology, accounting, auditing.
